25-250 TRUMP V. V.O.S. SELECTIONS, INC.
DECISION BELOW: 2025 WL 2490634
THE MOTION TO EXPEDITE AND THE PETITION FOR A WRIT OF CERTIORARI ARE GRANTED.
CONSOLIDATED WITH 24-1287 FOR ONE HOUR ORAL ARGUMENT. EXPEDITED BRIEFING. THE
CASES WILL BE SET FOR ARGUMENT IN THE FIRST WEEK OF THE NOVEMBER 2025 ARGUMENT
SESSION.
CERT. GRANTED 9/9/2025
QUESTION PRESENTED:
1. Whether the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), Pub. L. No. 95-
223, Tit. II, 91 Stat. 1626, authorizes the tariffs imposed by President Trump pursuant to the
national emergencies declared or continued in Proclamation 10,886 and Executive Orders
14,157, 14,193, 14,194, 14,195, and 14,257, as amended.
2. If IEEPA authorizes the tariffs, whether the statute unconstitutionally delegates
legislative authority to the President.
LOWER COURT CASE NUMBER: 2025-1812, 2025-1813
